$comment: What a creative world starts with (IDEAL-MACHINES-PLAN decision 53; IM-6's pass, decision 22), granted once, at creation, into the pocket. Counts are in the hotbar's units: a body, a cubic metre, a piece. Every mod's kits are summed; one kit may set the row and one may put a pack on. Sensors and quarries join this file with their slices (collapse f-2, IM-8, IM-9). The first vacuum cell placed in a creative world arrives holding 1 GJ, once; that is decision 23's door, not this file's.
